translations.*獨立別墅、門口好停車、同一區塊只有四間相同的別墅，間距大隱私性好；室內寬敞有客: *Independent villa with easy parking at the entrance. Only four identical villas in the same block, spaciously spaced for good privacy. The interior is spacious with a living room, sofa, TV, and a fully equipped open kitchen. There is one room with two single beds, two rooms with double beds, two toilets for convenience, and only one bathroom. Additionally, there is a washing machine, large refrigerator, and air conditioning in every room. The downside is that it is very dark and quiet outside at night, the nearest convenience store is about a 5-minute drive away, and walking at night is difficult due to darkness. There are ants in the living room (a common issue in villas). Overall, considering the price, it’s quite good.*
translations.*直接左上角投鈔票就能玩，規則大概是看倍率、開獎率挑幾台、先打左邊，累積到一定程: *You can play by directly inserting coins in the top left corner. The basic rule is to check the payout rate and jackpot probability, choose a few machines, start by playing the left side, and after accumulating to a certain point, trigger the right side to start accumulating rewards/payouts.*
translations.*真的是非常驚險，差一點就趕不上。*\n\n: *It was really thrilling, almost missed the chance.*

translations.[**Churasun 6 沖繩 （ちゅらさん6）辣妹酒吧 表演觀賞門票預約 (: [**Churasun 6 Okinawa (ちゅらさん6) Gal Bar Show Ticket Reservation (Okinawa Naha・Show)**](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/181495?cid=19365){:target="_blank"} **—** One show starts at 20:30, no all-you-can-drink, front row seat: NT$1,369
translations.[**日本・沖繩｜青洞潛水、浮潛體驗｜青之洞窟屋｜多語教練、早晨下午時段優惠**: [**Japan Okinawa｜Blue Cave Diving and Snorkeling Experience｜Blue Cave House｜Multilingual Instructors, Morning and Afternoon Discounts**](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/20577-japan-okinawa-blue-cave-snorkeling-diving-tour-limited-discounted-sessions?cid=19365){:target="_blank"} **—** 10:30, 【5/1〜9/30】Snorkeling Plan (Gather 15 minutes before): NT$851/person
translations.[**日本沖繩｜宇流麻市 CAVE OKINAWA 鍾乳石洞**](https:: [**Okinawa, Japan | Uruma City CAVE OKINAWA Stalactite Cave**](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/165866?cid=19365){:target="_blank"}: NT$216
translations.[**沖繩美麗海水族館**](https://www.kkday.com/zh-: [**Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium**](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/18680-okinawa-churaumi-aquarium-admission-ticket-japan?cid=19365){:target="_blank"} **—** E-ticket: NT$413 / person + bonus 7-day 21GB total eSIM
translations.[Donki](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8e7RBUAb: [Donki](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8e7RBUAbrJsEt8qz8){:target="_blank"} also has an Okinawan style. There are two Donki stores on Kokusai Street; we ate and parked near the smaller one. (The other one is larger)
translations._整體來說規模不大， **體驗算是有看到鐘乳石而已** ，下次有機會會想去規模更: _Overall, it's not very large, **the experience mainly involves seeing stalactites only**. Next time, I'd like to visit the larger [Gyokusendo Cave: Okinawa World Culture Kingdom](https://okinawa.letsgojp.com/archives/757370/){:target="*blank"} (it's actually near where we stayed, but we couldn't fit it into our schedule)._
translations.一樓有 Chiikawa 咖啡廳，可以內用或外帶喝的 — 兔兔氣泡飲。\n\n: On the first floor, there is the Chiikawa Café, where you can dine in or take out — featuring the Bunny Sparkling Drink.
translations.一樣是先買食券交給店員然後入座。\n\n: First, buy a meal ticket and give it to the staff before taking a seat.
translations.一進來就是一整片的熱帶水族缸:\n\n: As soon as you enter, there is a large tropical aquarium:
translations.下午的飛機就是舒服，大約中午抵達機場，沒什麼人。\n\n: Afternoon flights are comfortable, arriving at the airport around noon with few people.
translations.下去沙灘要注意腳下有很多寄居蟹，不得不佩服日本的環境保護，雖然沖繩觀光很熱門但是: When going down to the beach, be careful of the many hermit crabs underfoot. I have to admire Japan's environmental protection. Although Okinawa is a popular tourist spot, the natural environment, including the snorkeling area we visited the next day, is still very well preserved and clean.
translations.下沙灘有一個鞦韆可以拍照，不過這時間是逆光拍起來臉會很黑。\n\n: There is a swing on the beach where you can take photos, but at this time, the backlighting will make faces appear very dark.
translations.下高速之後走市區道路，這時間車很多，小擁堵。\n\n: After exiting the highway, we took city roads. At this time, there were many cars, causing slight congestion.
translations.中午時分，我們先在 2F 隨便吃了一家迴轉壽司後，吃飽才有力氣逛。\n\n: Around noon, we first had a casual meal at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant on the 2nd floor. After eating, we had the energy to explore.
translations.主要是餵食其他魚群，可以看到魟魚翻跟斗；鯨鯊的話對這些餌料沒什麼興趣。\n\n: Mainly feeding other fish groups; you can see stingrays doing flips. Whale sharks are not very interested in this bait.
translations.也有一些吃的可供選擇。\n\n: There are also some food options available.
translations.今天沒行程，早上沒事做去體驗一下打柏青哥。\n\n: No plans today, so I tried playing pachinko in the morning.
translations.個人覺得應該蠻符合台灣人的口味，控肉很嫩，配上有嚼勁的沖繩麵還有日式湯頭，我覺得: I personally think it suits Taiwanese tastes well. The braised pork is tender, paired with the chewy Okinawa noodles and Japanese-style broth. I find it quite delicious. (I'm not a fan of Taiwanese braised pork noodles that are too salty.)
translations.停好車之後往出口方向走(上圖往左邊走是汽車出口，圖中這邊都是入口)，找到教練的車: After parking, walk towards the exit (in the picture, the car exit is to the left; the area shown is all entrances). Find the coach’s license plate 75–18 to check in. (For meeting point details, please refer to the itinerary information. This refers to [our information this time](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/20577-japan-okinawa-blue-cave-snorkeling-diving-tour-limited-discounted-sessions?cid=19365){:target="_blank"} )
translations.停好車，開逛！這裡有一大片跟一整座的停車塔不怕沒位子(免費)。\n\n: Park the car and start exploring! There is a large open lot and a whole parking tower, so no worries about finding a spot (free of charge).
translations.停車場(免費停車)旁就是售票亭，但我們已經先在 [線上買好票了](https:/: The ticket booth is right next to the parking lot (free parking), but we had already purchased tickets [online](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/165866?cid=19365){:target="_blank"}.
translations.價格比起其他的也是非常實惠。\n\n: The price is also very affordable compared to others.
translations.先去餐券機買餐券交給店員後入座。\n\n: First, buy a meal ticket from the vending machine and give it to the staff before taking a seat.
translations.免稅櫃檯在 4F 等待結帳的排了一整圈，人山人海；因為我昨天已經買夠了，就沒再買: The duty-free counter on the 4th floor had a long queue all around, packed with people; since I had already bought enough yesterday, I didn't buy anything more. However, my friend said that although the line was long, it moved quickly.
translations.入口後再一路往下走到洞口。\n\n: After entering, continue walking down to the cave entrance.
translations.入場時會有對應的舞者帶位、附贈一杯飲品(可選酒精、無酒精)，個人覺得剛好，不太需: Upon entry, a designated dancer will guide you to your seat and you will receive a complimentary drink (alcoholic or non-alcoholic). Personally, I think this is just right, and there's no need to buy an all-you-can-drink package as it doesn't add much value.
translations.內容多元但是份量都不大，每一種都是嚐嚐味道，右上角是沖繩有名的阿古豬(但也是一人: The variety is diverse but the portions are small, just enough to taste each type. The top right is Okinawa's famous Agu pork (but still only one slice per person).
translations.全程約 80 分鐘左右。\n\n: The whole process takes about 80 minutes.
translations.再往前有鯊魚缸。\n\n: There is a shark tank further ahead.
translations.再繼續往前就能看到黑潮之海巨型水族缸的完整樣貌，高度約 3 層樓高，B1 有咖啡: Continuing forward, you can see the full view of the Kuroshio Sea giant aquarium, which is about three stories high. On B1, there is a café where you can enjoy close encounters with the ocean.
translations.出咖啡廳後往上走一小段再往下走轉個彎就回到停車場了。\n\n: After leaving the café, walk up a short distance, then go down and turn a corner to return to the parking lot.
translations.出境安檢倒是蠻快的。\n\n: The departure security check was quite quick.
translations.出境後也還有很多伴手禮店可以補買。\n\n: There are still many souvenir shops available for last-minute purchases after departure.
translations.出山洞後再往上走一小段就會看到 [FOREST CAFE By CAVE OKI: After exiting the cave, walk a short distance uphill to find [FOREST CAFE By CAVE OKINAWA](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xh4pHQwgT3jaYBcJ6){:target="_blank"}.
translations.前幾天去的是 [另一家比較小家的](https://maps.app.goo.g: A few days ago, we went to [another smaller place](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8e7RBUAbrJsEt8qz8){:target="_blank"} in a different direction; this one is bigger and busier, so we parked directly in the lot across the street.
translations.前幾天都很早出門，今天終於可以 chill 了。\n\n: In the past few days, we left early every day. Today, we can finally chill.
translations.剛好波上宮對面的停車場有位子，就直接停了。\n\n: There happened to be a parking spot available right across from Naminoue Shrine, so we parked there directly.
translations.參拜完我們也走去大家很常在 IG 看到的波上宮拍攝點 — [陸橋人行道波上宮拍攝: After the shrine visit, we also went to the popular photo spot at Naminoue Shrine often seen on Instagram — [Naminoue Shrine Overpass Pedestrian Walkway Photo Spot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XMDihcbXvHkzhx8j9){:target="_blank"}.
translations.另外還在 Parco City 買了幾件衣服，這次沒買太多東西。\n\n: Also bought a few clothes at Parco City, but didn't buy much this time.
translations.可以看到沙灘也幾乎沒人，接近中午太可怕了。\n\n: You can see that the beach is almost empty; approaching noon is too intense.
translations.可能因為調度問題，我們在這等了差不多 40 分鐘接駁車才來。\n\n: Possibly due to scheduling issues, we waited here for nearly 40 minutes before the shuttle bus arrived.
translations.右轉搭乘手扶梯往下就是室內入口:\n\n: Turn right and take the escalator down to the indoor entrance:
translations.吃飽之後我們就去附近最後一個 Outlet 景點逛逛。\n\n: After eating, we went to the nearby last outlet shopping spot to browse around.
translations.嚴禁觸碰：舞者會下來跟觀眾互動，除了擊掌、合照之外，嚴禁其他肢體接觸。\n: Strictly No Touching: Dancers will come down to interact with the audience. Besides high-fives and photos, no other physical contact is allowed.
translations.四晚：NT $26,070 / 5人，平均下來 **每人每晚 NT $1,304: 4 nights: NT $26,070 / 5 people, averaging **NT $1,304 per person per night**
translations.回去之前一樣去 Lawson 買買吃的喝的，這是因為之前石油危機原物料短缺出的黑: Before heading back, we went to Lawson to buy some food and drinks. This was because of a limited edition black-and-white printed chip packaging released during the previous oil crisis and raw material shortages.
translations.因為晚上還有琉球牛訂位要回國際通，所以只看了看海龜就準備出發回那霸了。\n\n: Because we had a Ryukyu beef reservation on Kokusai Street in the evening, we only took a quick look at the sea turtles before heading back to Naha.
translations.在沖繩的最後一晚，當然也是要吃吃喝喝。\n\n: On the last night in Okinawa, of course, we had to eat and drink.
translations.地點是唯一缺點，離最熱鬧的國際通車程約需 45 分鐘:\n: The location is the only drawback, about a 45-minute drive from the busiest Kokusai Street:
translations.外面氣溫約 30 度，裡面只有 23.5 度很涼爽。\n\n: The outside temperature is about 30 degrees, while inside it is only 23.5 degrees, very cool.
translations.外面電視牆就是 Churasun 6 辣妹酒吧的廣告。\n\n: The outdoor TV wall shows an advertisement for Churasun 6, a hostess bar.
translations.大約等到 11:40 第一批顧客吃完之後就有位子了。\n\n: Around 11:40, after the first group of customers finished eating, a seat became available.
translations.天氣跟水質都很好。\n\n: The weather and water quality were both excellent.
translations.太陽很大很曬，建議穿長袖泳衣。\n\n: The sun is very strong and hot; it is recommended to wear a long-sleeve swimsuit.
translations.如果要買電子用品可以過馬路去對面別館逛逛。\n\n: If you want to buy electronic products, you can cross the street to the annex building opposite.
translations.完全 *沒想到有這 Part，我還想說為什麼回程路上 Sean 堅持要去大創，原: I *totally didn’t expect this part. I was wondering why Sean insisted on going to Daiso on the way back, and it turns out he wanted to buy candles! So touching.*
translations.實際應該能住到 6 人，三房（一間雙單人床房＋兩間雙人床房）: Host 是說含: Actually, it can accommodate up to 6 people with three bedrooms (one room with a double and single bed + two rooms with double beds): The host says including the living room sofa bed, it can fit up to 10 people.
translations.小費：可以跟任何一位工作人員直接用現金買代金券，一張 ￥100，最低一次買 10: Tips: You can buy vouchers directly from any staff member with cash. Each voucher is ￥100, and the minimum purchase is 10 vouchers for ￥1,000. To give a tip, wait for the dancer to lift the bikini strap before slipping it in.
translations.座位上跟上次心得差不多，位置大小跟虎航差不多，但是椅子是皮椅舒適度比較差。\n\: The seat is similar to my last review, with size and space comparable to Tigerair, but the leather chair is less comfortable.
translations.廉航沒東西吃，先把肚子吃飽。\n\n: No food on the budget airline, so let's eat first to fill our stomachs.
translations.往回頭上樓梯進入鍾乳洞(要小心地滑跟注意頭頂)。\n\n: Go back up the stairs to enter the cave (be careful of slippery floors and watch your head).
translations.後來查其實可以直接從波上宮另一側下去比較近。\n\n: Later, I found out that you can actually go down from the other side of Naminoue Shrine, which is closer.
translations.後來走累了就先去麥當勞吃東西等其他朋友採購完。\n\n: Later, when we got tired from walking, we went to McDonald's to eat while waiting for the other friends to finish shopping.
translations.從 20:15 吃到快 22:30 才結束 Zzzz。\n\n: From 20:15 until nearly 22:30, we ate. Zzzz.
translations.從 [真栄田岬駐車場](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gnVu: About a 10-minute drive from [Maeda Cape Parking Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gnVubgQJVA3PKwSn9){:target="_blank"}.
translations.從圖一進去後直走到底左轉再往上走到 2F 就會看到 Churasun6 入口招牌: Enter from Figure 1, go straight to the end, turn left, then go up to the 2nd floor to see the Churasun6 entrance sign. (The 1st floor is a nightclub, don't go there by mistake)
translations.從美國村走路過去大約 15 分鐘。\n\n: It's about a 15-minute walk from American Village.
translations.快到 20:30 就能排隊等待工作人員查看購買憑證驗票。\n\n: Around 20:30, you can line up to wait for the staff to check your purchase voucher for ticket verification.
translations.感謝您閱讀我的旅遊紀錄，希望你會喜歡。\n\n: Thank you for reading my travel journal. I hope you enjoy it.
translations.我們在 14–15 這邊等租車公司的人來接我們。\n\n: We waited here at 14–15 for the rental car company staff to pick us up.
translations.我們大概 11:30 離開，去瀨長島。\n\n: We left around 11:30 and headed to Senaga Island.
translations.我們是穿好泳衣出門，所以直接去找教練報到，東西都丟車上，車鑰匙給教練保管。\n\: We wore our swimsuits before heading out, so we went straight to check in with the instructor. We left our belongings in the car and gave the car keys to the instructor for safekeeping.
translations.我們是約 10:30 的 [浮潛](https://www.kkday.com/: We booked the [snorkeling](https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/20577-japan-okinawa-blue-cave-snorkeling-diving-tour-limited-discounted-sessions?cid=19365){:target="_blank"} for around 10:30 and needed to check in before 10:15.
translations.我們是約 20:15 的，到國際通停好車晃了一下。\n\n: We arrived around 20:15, parked at Kokusai Street, and took a stroll.
translations.我們有人點 10 種、有人點 14 種。\n\n: Some of us ordered 10 kinds, others ordered 14 kinds.
translations.我們沒要買唐吉的東西，就在國際通隨便走走逛逛。\n\n: We didn't plan to buy anything from Don Quijote, so we just strolled around Kokusai Street casually.
translations.我們走紅色的路線繞了一大圈。\n\n: We took the red route and made a big loop.
translations.我是點沾麵，湯頭濃郁，肉也好吃，麵的份量很大，點一般大小就吃不完了。\n\n: I ordered dipping noodles with a rich broth and tasty meat. The noodle portion was very large—I couldn't finish a regular size.
translations.戶外 Outlet 很曬，二樓也有一家藥妝店。\n\n: The outdoor outlet is very sunny, and there is also a drugstore on the second floor.
translations.搭手扶梯往下後還有紀念品店，之前社群很紅的巨型扭蛋貌似是結束了，沒看到。\n\n: After taking the escalator down, there is a souvenir shop. The giant capsule toy machine that was popular on social media seems to have ended, as it was not seen.
translations.旁邊就有停車場。\n\n: There is a parking lot right next to it.
translations.早點或晚點才有黑潮探索，可以從上方觀看鯨鯊；這時間只有 15:30 餵食。\n\: The Kuroshio Exploration is only available early or late in the day, allowing you to see whale sharks from above; feeding time is only at 15:30.
translations.明天早上要去浮潛，除了先買好早餐先吃飽外還多買鹽糖備著。\n\n: Tomorrow morning we will go snorkeling. Besides buying breakfast in advance to eat well, also buy some salted candy to have on hand.
translations.昨天琉球牛只吃到一片阿古豬實在不夠，今天補齊。\n\n: Yesterday, I only had one slice of Agu pork with the Ryukyu beef, which wasn't enough, so today I made up for it.
translations.時間晚了，我們直接找停車場附近的居酒屋吃吃；沒想到意外的好，價格實惠+東西好吃！: It was late, so we just picked an izakaya near the parking lot to eat; unexpectedly, it was great—affordable prices and delicious food!
translations.晚上的美國村燈火通明，夜景很美；但是我們一早就出門去潛水，吃完晚餐後已經很累，所: The American Village is brightly lit at night, and the night view is beautiful. However, we went diving early in the morning, and after dinner, we were very tired, so we just passed through and headed back to our accommodation.
translations.最後一路往上走就出山洞了。\n\n: Finally, walk all the way up to exit the cave.
translations.最後走走逛逛，這條商店街也是什麼都有，伴手禮店、無印良品、藥妝…等等\n\n: Finally, take a stroll around. This shopping street has everything: souvenir shops, Muji, drugstores, and more.
translations.最後還投了一瓶這次都沒看到的生可樂回台灣喝。\n\n: Finally, I brought back a bottle of fresh cola, which I never got to see during this trip, to drink in Taiwan.
translations.有一整棟超大的免費停車塔可以停。\n\n: There is a large free parking tower available.
translations.有任何問題及指教歡迎 [與我聯絡](https://www.zhgchg.li/: If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to [contact me](https://www.zhgchg.li/contact){:target="_blank"}.
translations.有種之前看 [**岡山城點燈**](../31b9b3a63abc/) 的感覺，: It feels similar to the previous experience of seeing [**Okayama Castle Lighting**](../31b9b3a63abc/). Japanese lighting design always meets a certain standard.
translations.本來想吃這邊的咖啡廳但是沒位子，而且太熱了，所以拍拍照就離開了。\n\n: Originally wanted to eat at the café here, but there were no seats and it was too hot, so just took some photos and left.
translations.本館逛完之後還可以繼續往海的方向走，外面還有海豚表演、海牛、海龜。\n\n: After exploring the main building, you can continue walking towards the sea, where there are dolphin shows, manatees, and sea turtles.
translations.核心中間那區一樓有很多商店小店可以逛、2 樓主要是餐廳。\n\n: The central core area on the first floor has many shops to explore, while the second floor mainly features restaurants.
translations.水質非常清澈，有很多熱帶魚。\n\n: The water is very clear, with many tropical fish.
translations.沖繩主要就一條高速公路由南到北縱貫。\n\n: Okinawa mainly has one highway running from south to north.
translations.沖繩晚上離開市區後街道真的很暗，幾乎沒有路燈，回去路上一樣先去住宿附近 Laws: After leaving the city area at night in Okinawa, the streets are really dark with almost no streetlights. On the way back, we first stopped at a Lawson near our accommodation to buy some food. (Still not full)
translations.沖繩的晚上街道真的很暗。\n\n: The streets in Okinawa are really dark at night.
translations.潛水完會很餓，大家幾乎都點了兩份 Tacos 的套餐＋飲料 ￥2,300。\n\: After diving, you'll be very hungry. Almost everyone ordered two taco set meals plus drinks for ￥2,300.
translations.當天路上車多，小塞了一下。\n\n: There was heavy traffic on the road that day, causing a slight jam.
translations.看到這車潮真的很抖，因為我們要在 10:15 前找到教練報到，前面至少排了 10: Seeing this traffic jam was really stressful because we had to check in with the instructor before 10:15. There were at least 10 cars ahead before reaching the parking lot entrance, and we were worried about being late.
translations.石川下之後大約再開 15 分鐘就會抵達停車場。\n\n: After Ishikawa, drive for about 15 more minutes to reach the parking lot.
translations.租車場大約距離機場 15 分鐘左右。\n\n: The car rental lot is about 15 minutes from the airport.
translations.終點就是青之洞窟，不過浮潛只進來拍個照就出去了，不會再深入。\n\n: The final stop is the Blue Cave, but we only snorkeled inside briefly to take photos and did not go deeper.
translations.給的蔬菜量也很多。\n\n: The amount of vegetables provided was also generous.
translations.統一在一樓的 TAX FREE COUNTER 退。\n\n: All tax refunds are processed at the TAX FREE COUNTER on the first floor.
translations.繼續往前開有很大的 FamilyMart 駐車場，可以在這邊買水族館門票跟消費一: Continuing forward, there is a large FamilyMart parking lot where you can buy aquarium tickets and make some purchases.
translations.繼續走就會來到「黑潮之海」水族缸 (7,500 m³ 的巨大水槽)\n\n: Continuing forward, you will reach the "Kuroshio Sea" aquarium tank (a huge tank with 7,500 m³).
translations.美國村停車場很多，一開始想停最裡面的沒位子，後來停靠外圍的停車場。\n\n: There are many parking lots in American Village. At first, we wanted to park in the innermost lot but it was full, so we parked in an outer lot instead.
translations.聲光效果很厲害，就是要讓你感官疲勞、一直玩下去；小玩了 ￥3,000 體驗一下，: The sound and light effects are impressive, designed to overwhelm your senses and keep you playing; I spent about ￥3,000 trying it out, didn't win, and called it a day.
translations.菜單跟怎麼烤都有詳細說明。\n\n: The menu and grilling instructions are explained in detail.
translations.表演非常震撼歡樂、舞台設計跟音樂也是一絕，絕無冷場；因為台灣遊客佔多數所以最後一: The performance was very exciting and joyful, with outstanding stage design and music—there was never a dull moment. Since most of the audience were Taiwanese tourists, the final part even included a rendition of Jolin Tsai's "Practice Dance Skills" along with dragon and lion dances.
translations.裡面也有很多漂亮的光影設計。\n\n: There are also many beautiful light and shadow designs inside.
translations.規模不大、時間也不長；加上我們跑錯地方了所以只看到一點點，不是在北谷公園這邊的海: The scale was small and the duration was short; plus, we went to the wrong place, so we only saw a little. The release was not at the beach near Chatan Park but on the seaside closer to American Village. The best viewing spot is at the [**Chatan Sunset Walk**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/njrjvninY4mUjVi17){:target="_blank"}.
translations.買一個冰淇淋消暑一夏，一出山洞又回到 30 度，很熱；另外這邊也有賣一些人介紹過: Buy an ice cream to cool off in the summer. Once you exit the cave, it’s back to 30 degrees, very hot; they also sell some Okinawa color-changing cups here (they feel like paper cups) that people have recommended.
translations.買不動了，稍微逛了一下就去對面的 Blue Seal 吃冰，來這麼多天都還沒吃過: Too full to eat more, so we just took a short walk and went to Blue Seal across the street for ice cream. Haven't tried it yet during our stay (Okinawa brand).
translations.買了 三球 琉球紅茶+巧克力+芒果 跟一個零錢包紀念品。\n\n: Bought three scoops: Ryukyu black tea, chocolate, and mango, plus a coin purse souvenir.
translations.買了一些熱食直接吃。\n\n: Bought some hot food to eat right away.
translations.走出來往 BUS Station 方向走，去租車公司的接駁會合點。\n\n: Walk out and head towards the BUS Station to the rental car company's shuttle meeting point.
translations.走到另一邊的另一家紀念品店買東西，這家很大，什麼都有，而且二樓還有廁所。\n\n: Walked to another souvenir shop on the other side. This one is very large, has everything, and there is a restroom on the second floor.
translations.越捷航空（廉價航空） **不含托運 NT $10,789 (手提 7 Kg)/: VietJet Air (Low-cost airline) **without checked baggage NT $10,789 (carry-on 7 Kg) / checked baggage one-way 15.0 kg + NT $1,297**; no choice, bad timing of birth, prices are just this high during summer vacation…
translations.距離住宿地點大約需要 1 小時 15 分鐘車程。\n\n: It takes about 1 hour and 15 minutes by car from the accommodation.
translations.距離開演時間 20:30 還很早，我們先在附近隨便吃吃晚餐。\n\n: It was still early before the show at 20:30, so we grabbed a casual dinner nearby first.
translations.路線大致如上圖， **整體規模不是很大** ，有看到部分區域正在整修、蓋新館，可: The route is roughly as shown in the image above. **The overall scale is not very large.** Some areas are under renovation or new buildings are being constructed, so the route may change in the future.
translations.途中經過港口，郵輪應該是在這邊上下客。\n\n: Passing by the port, the cruise ship should be boarding and disembarking passengers here.
translations.這個鳳梨 Orion 還不錯！冰的話有點太甜。\n\n: This Pineapple Orion is pretty good! It's a bit too sweet when served cold.
translations.這時間已經沒什麼店在營業了，索性就逛逛藥妝跟 [Donki](https://m: At this time, most stores were closed, so we just browsed the drugstores and [Donki](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8e7RBUAbrJsEt8qz8){:target="_blank"}.
translations.這裡也有另外一家有賣 吉伊卡哇師薩的專賣店，不過東西都差不多。\n\n: There is also another specialty store here selling Jiikawa Shisa, but the products are quite similar.
translations.這裡可以直接看到那霸機場飛機起降，這時間來非常曬。\n\n: You can directly see planes taking off and landing at Naha Airport here. It’s very sunny at this time.
translations.這裡有一家有賣 [chiikawa 沖繩師薩的紀念品店](https://map: There is a shop here that sells [chiikawa Okinawa Shisa souvenirs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/F8wBujEZ9sCn6Ge86){:target="_blank"}:
translations.這裡有四戶別墅，PALM VILLA 是拐進來左手邊第一間。\n\n: There are four villas here. PALM VILLA is the first one on the left after you turn in.
translations.這邊有廁所、公共衛浴可換衣服、沖洗(￥200/1分40秒)、置物櫃(￥100)、: There are toilets and public showers for changing clothes and rinsing (￥200/1 minute 40 seconds), lockers (￥100), but no towels or toiletries provided.
translations.進去後先直走到底，觀看介紹影片。\n\n: After entering, go straight to the end and watch the introductory video.
translations.遇到外籍教練，至少英文是通的；全程大約如上圖不會太遠，如果踢不動也可以靠教練拖著: When encountering a foreign coach, at least English is understood; the whole route is roughly as shown in the picture and not too far. If you get tired, the coach can help pull you back; just be careful of the coral reefs when getting in and out of the water.
translations.門口可以停車，它是一棟海灘邊的建築物。\n\n: Parking is available at the entrance. It is a building by the beach.
translations.附近漁港雖然有很多空地，但都禁止停車，需要停在附近的停車場 [Maekaneku: Although there are many open spaces near the fishing port, parking is prohibited. You need to park at the nearby [Maekaneku Fishing Port Parking Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/o3yk3sf2k9S3BKXN9){:target="_blank"}.
translations.青之洞窟浮潛、美麗海水族館、美國村、Churasun 6 辣妹表演。\n\n: Blue Cave snorkeling, Churaumi Aquarium, American Village, Churasun 6 girl show.
translations.靠外一側是咖啡廳座位。\n\n: The outer side has café seating.
translations.食物飲料普普通通，稍作休息之後就繼續出發了。\n\n: The food and drinks were ordinary. After a short break, we continued on our journey.
translations.驗完票之後往回走爬一段小坡找到入口。\n\n: After ticket inspection, walk back and climb a small slope to find the entrance.
translations.點了一些天婦羅、飯糰、麵、烤串、還有類似糖醋魚的料理（好吃）、啤酒飲料，加一加才: We ordered some tempura, rice balls, noodles, grilled skewers, and a dish similar to sweet and sour fish (delicious), along with beer and drinks. The total came to only ¥14,210 for 5 people.
